datePolicy: Retains the source register access date 2026-11-06 (Taiwan/Singapore local date; UTC receipts may be 2026-11-05). No external research or refresh during localization. Copy editing is not a visa, legal, price, wage, bank-policy or availability refresh.
uncertainties: No 2027 visa application timetable was found in the original dated check. June 1, 2027 remains conditional for a new applicant; 2026 windows are historical, and late June/July is only a personal fallback.

Taiwan residence, a valid Taiwan passport with ID number, submission age and previous approval history remain consequential eligibility conditions. Entry validity, collection deadline and landing residence period are separate clocks; official case-specific instructions control.

Eight housing observations cover only directly managed Oakhouse rooms. Five selected rooms were full and three showed future dates; no June 2027 vacancy, address-registration permission or final invoice is confirmed. Gender restrictions apply.

Housing base estimates exclude optional bedding, utility overages, damage/odor cleaning and payment costs. Contract fee is nonrefundable, mandatory pad is additional, advance rent/holding and notice rules can alter cash timing or liability.

FX rates, flights, private insurance and cash envelopes are planning assumptions, not live quotes. Two 30-day budgeting months are not the exact 61-day date range. Large medical costs, major trips, tuition and major purchases are excluded; no wages assumed.

NHI reserve is not an assessed premium; pension relief and bank approval are not guaranteed. Ward rules, employer coverage, foreign-exchange classification, remaining permission and provider checks affect procedures and actual charges.

Wage figures are dated legal-floor/employer observations, not a city-wide average, future rate, guaranteed job, hours or take-home pay. Working Holiday remains holiday-first and prohibited premises remain excluded.
Traditional Chinese likely better fits Taiwan applicants. Simplified Chinese is supplied only for this local package; translation does not broaden passport eligibility.
editingContract: Reader-first English and package-only Simplified Chinese; exact bilingual numeric/date/external URL multiplicity and corresponding table-cell parity. Local drafts only; no Review/stars or public attachment promises.
